title: Assistant Manager - SC Agro
description:
**Overview**
Responsible for driving Contract Farming (CF) operations across the Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram geography to ensure sustainable procurement of quality potatoes for Lay's and Uncle chips. The role is accountable for expanding the farmer base, strengthening procurement networks, managing storage operations, and ensuring uninterrupted supplies to manufacturing plants while building strategic partnerships with farmers, aggregators, cold storages, government agencies, and other stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Contract Farming Development
* Lead the expansion and execution of Contract Farming programs across Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram.
* Identify and develop new potato-growing clusters, multiplication pockets, and farmer networks to increase program penetration and ensure long-term supply sustainability.
* Drive seed sales, farmer enrolment, and adoption of recommended agronomic practices (POP) through regular field engagement.
* Ensure timely seed distribution, crop monitoring, and technical advisory to achieve quality and productivity targets.
* Strengthen relationships with farmers, aggregators, FPOs, cooperatives, and channel partners to improve farmer retention and program scalability.
* Procurement & Supply Assurance
* Own regional procurement targets for both Contract Farming (CF) and Non-Contract Farming (NCF) potatoes within approved commercial and quality specifications.
* Ensure uninterrupted month-wise and season-wise supply of potatoes from Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram to manufacturing plants.
* Monitor crop quality parameters including TPoD, solids, reducing sugars, and chip-grade specifications.
* Develop market intelligence on crop acreage, arrivals, pricing trends, competitor activities, and procurement opportunities to support commercial decision-making.
* Drive chip-grade procurement programs while ensuring quality compliance and minimizing pilferage.
* Cold Storage & Inventory Management
* Identify, onboard, and manage strategic cold storage partners across Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram.
* Lead long-storage planning, inventory monitoring, quality management, and phased evacuation to ensure uninterrupted plant supplies throughout the storage season.
* Work closely with storage operators, transport partners, and manufacturing teams to optimize inventory utilization and minimize storage losses.
* Stakeholder & Government Engagement
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Agriculture and Horticulture Departments, Mandi Boards, district administration, and other government agencies across Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram.
* Partner with FPOs, cooperatives, research institutions, and local organizations to strengthen farmer engagement and expand Contract Farming initiatives.
* Organize farmer meetings, field demonstrations, extension programs, and government-led initiatives to enhance program visibility and adoption.
* Operational Excellence & Compliance
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procurement processes, statutory requirements, and documentation standards.
* Oversee seed sale documentation, procurement records, mandi tax compliance, transportation documentation, and audit readiness.
* Establish and monitor field quality laboratories, cook tests, and procurement quality protocols.
* Promote adoption of digital agriculture tools, satellite-based crop monitoring, precision farming, and data-driven decision-making.
* Ensure operational discipline among aggregators, transporters, cold storage partners, and suppliers.
* Team Leadership & Capability Building
* Lead and develop the regional Agro team through coaching, mentoring, and technical capability building.
* Support implementation of an effective extension model to strengthen farmer connect and improve field execution.
* Foster a high-performance culture through structured reviews, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
* Strategic & Sustainability Initiatives
* Drive sustainability initiatives including Sustainable farming practices (SFP), regenerative agriculture, and other resource-efficient farming practices across the region.
* Support R&D initiatives involving new potato varieties, agronomic practices, crop protection molecules, and field demonstrations.

**Qualifications**
Experience & Qualifications
  
  
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in agriculture (B.Sc. Agriculture) is preferable.
* MBA/Postgraduate qualification in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Marketing, or Supply Chain is preferred.

**Experience**

* 6–8 years of experience in Contract Farming, agricultural procurement, agri-input sales, or agri-supply chain management.
* Strong experience working with potato farming ecosystems, cold storage operations, and farmer engagement in North Bengal, Bihar, or similar geographies.
* Demonstrated ability to manage government stakeholders, FPOs, traders, transporters, and cold storage partners.
* Proven leadership skills with experience in leading field teams and driving regional business outcomes.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Contract Farming Development
* Farmer & Aggregator Relationship Management
* Potato Procurement & Market Intelligence
* Cold Storage & Inventory Management
* Commercial Negotiation
* Government & Institutional Liaison
* Supply Chain Planning & Execution
* Team Leadership & Capability Development
* Data Analytics & Digital Agriculture
* Sustainability & Regenerative Agriculture

Problem Solving & Execution Excellence

title: Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description**
PayNearby, founded in April 2016, is a DPIIT-certified organization and India’s leading branchless banking and digital network. Operating on a B2B2C model, it partners with neighborhood retail stores to equip them with tools for delivering digital and financial services to local communities. The company’s mission is to make financial and digital services accessible to everyone, everywhere, by simplifying advanced technology for last-mile use. Through its tech-led Distribution as a Service (DaaS) network, PayNearby enables services such as cash transactions, ecommerce, credit, insurance, travel, and utility payments. Its network of over 1.5 million retail partners across 20,000+ PIN codes serves more than 50 million customers and facilitates 250 million transactions annually.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Sales Manager role based in Howrah. The Sales Manager will lead and manage local sales operations, drive partner acquisition and activation, and ensure revenue growth through PayNearby’s network of retail partners. Responsibilities include developing and executing sales plans, monitoring performance metrics, and providing guidance and support to the field sales team. The role involves building strong relationships with retailers and distribution partners, conducting market visits, gathering feedback, and identifying opportunities to expand services and improve customer reach. The Sales Manager will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align sales activities with business goals and ensure compliance with company policies and standards.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong sales and business development skills, including pipeline management, negotiation, and closing abilities.
* Candidates should possess experience in channel management, retailer onboarding, and relationship-building with distribution partners.
* Candidates should possess skills in planning and executing sales strategies, setting targets, and monitoring performance metrics.
* Candidates should possess solid communication and interpersonal skills to lead teams, present ideas clearly, and collaborate across functions.
* Candidates should possess analytical and problem-solving skills to interpret data, understand market trends, and make informed decisions.
* Relevant experience in fintech, financial services, or FMCG field sales is beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
* Ability to work on-site in Howrah, travel within the assigned territory, and manage a field sales team effectively.

Uttrayan Financial Services Limited is an RBI-registered NBFC-MFI and a leading microfinance institution with a strong presence across Eastern India. Since 2001, the organization has focused on expanding financial access for underserved communities, especially underprivileged women in rural and semi-urban areas. Uttrayan operates in 10 states and 74 districts, supporting over 100,000 individuals on their path to financial independence through a range of responsible, livelihood-focused financial products. The company offers diverse loan products such as Prochesta, Pragati, Business Promotion, and Business Scale-up Loans to drive income generation and sustainable economic growth. As the only MFI in West Bengal partnering with State Bank of India for a Co-Lending project and collaborating with SIDBI on the Prayaas Scheme, Uttrayan has further expanded its portfolio with secure, multi-layer protected Gold Loans for agricultural, MSME, and personal needs.
  
**Role Description**
The Gold Loan role is a full-time, on-site position based at the Habra I branch. The role involves managing end-to-end gold loan operations, including customer onboarding, KYC verification, loan processing, documentation, and secure handling of pledged gold assets. The team member will explain product features and repayment terms, assess eligibility, and maintain accurate records in line with company policies and regulatory guidelines. Daily responsibilities include conducting customer interactions, monitoring repayment schedules, supporting collection activities, and ensuring adherence to the organization’s seven-layer security and insurance protocols. The role also requires close coordination with branch staff, promoting Gold Loan products in the local community, and contributing to portfolio growth while maintaining high standards of customer service and risk management.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to explain loan terms clearly and build trust with diverse clients.
* Basic financial, lending, or microfinance knowledge, including familiarity with documentation, KYC norms, and regulatory compliance.
* Attention to detail and integrity in handling valuables, records, and security procedures related to gold loan operations.
* Proficiency in using branch-level IT systems and basic computer applications for data entry and reporting.
* Ability to work on-site in Habra I, collaborate effectively with branch teams, and engage with local communities for business development.
* Prior experience in gold loans, banking, NBFCs, or microfinance will be an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: Higher Secondary or Graduate degree in any discipline; additional training in finance or banking is preferable.
* Comfort with field visits, when required, and commitment to Uttrayan’s mission of inclusive financial empowerment.
